text: Singapore carried out 17 executions in 2025, 15 of them for drug-related offences. In August 2026, UN human rights experts condemned the execution of at least 16 people in Singapore for drug-related offences that year and urged it to end its unlawful use of the death penalty.

source.name: Amnesty International: Death Sentences and Executions 2025 (ACT 50/0778/2026)
source.quote: Out of the 17 executions of 2025, two were carried out for murder, three for instigating drug trafficking and 12 for drug trafficking.
